## Signal direction mapping
BULLISH = ['bullish', 'buy', 'oversold', 'accumulation', 'golden_cross', 'above_vwap'…]
BEARISH = ['bearish', 'sell', 'overbought', 'distribution', 'death_cross', 'below_vwap'…]

## Per-indicator weight in category (after normalization)
net_score = Σ( strength × normalized_weight × direction )  # direction ∈ {+1, 0, −1}
⚡
Signal Fusion (Pass 1)
Weighted ensemble · score range −1.0 (bearish) to +1.0 (bullish)
SignalFusion class
Aggregates category scores with regime-adjusted weights into a single fused score + confidence metric.
## Pass 1 fusion (technical only)
fused_score = momentum_score × 0.25
           + volatility_score × 0.20
           + volume_score × 0.25
           + trend_score × 0.30

## Confidence = agreement of indicators
confidence = (agreement_rate × 0.4 + strength_factor × 0.4 + category_factor × 0.2)
            # agreement_rate = agreeing_indicators / total_indicators
            # strength_factor = min(1.0, abs(fused_score) × 2)
            # category_factor = categories_agreeing / total_categories
Fused ScoreInterpretationSignal
+0.5 to +1.0Strong bullish alignmentBUY
+0.15 to +0.5Moderate bullishBUY
−0.15 to +0.15Mixed / consolidationHOLD
−0.5 to −0.15Moderate bearishSELL
−1.0 to −0.5Strong bearish alignmentSELL

Filter & Rank Candidates
Apply confidence + score thresholds · select Top 10
150 → 10 stocks
Pass 1 results filtered by minimum confidence (≥50%) and min fused score (≥20%), then ranked by |fused_score|.
# Filter criteria
MIN_CONFIDENCE = 0.50  # 50%
MIN_SCORE      = 0.20  # 20%
NEWS_CANDIDATES = 10   # Top N for Pass 2

actionable = [r for r in results
    if r['signal'] in ['BUY', 'SELL']
    and r['confidence'] >= MIN_CONFIDENCE]
actionable.sort(key=abs(fused_score), reverse=True)
candidates = actionable[:NEWS_CANDIDATES]
💡 Only 10 of 150 stocks proceed to the expensive Pass 2 (news fetch + NLP). This reduces API calls from ~150 to 10 per cycle.

## FinBERT sentiment pipeline
inputs = tokenizer(text, max_length=512, truncation=True)
probs = softmax(model(**inputs).logits)  # [pos, neg, neu]
finbert_score = probs[positive] − probs[negative]

## Ensemble with Portuguese lexicon
ensemble = 0.7 × finbert_score + 0.3 × lexicon_score

## Portuguese financial lexicon weights (sample)
positive: alta(+1.5), lucro(+1.6), recorde(+1.7), crescimento(+1.4)…
negative: queda(−1.5), prejuízo(−1.7), crise(−1.6), risco(−1.0)…

Fusion Recalculation with News
News sentiment incorporated as 15% weight in final fused score
Pass 2 Final
Candidates re-ranked by updated fusion score. News also adjusts confidence ±5% depending on alignment with signal direction.
## Pass 2 fusion (with news — from monitor_live.py)
fused_score = 0.40 × trend_score
           + 0.25 × momentum_score
           + 0.20 × volatility_score
           + 0.15 × news_sentiment  # ← new!

## Confidence adjustment based on news alignment
if signal == 'BUY' and news > +0.10:  confidence += 0.05
if signal == 'BUY' and news < −0.10:  confidence −= 0.05
if signal == 'SELL' and news < −0.10: confidence += 0.05
if signal == 'SELL' and news > +0.10: confidence −= 0.05
Note: Trend gets higher weight (40% vs 30%) in Pass 2 to reflect its proven reliability after news narrows the candidate pool.

Position Sizing
Kelly Criterion with confidence scaling + volatility adjustment
10% – 40% range
Base 20% allocation scaled by confidence multiplier and fused score strength. High-volatility stocks receive 20% reduction.
1
Base allocation: 20%
2
Confidence multiplier: confidence / 0.60  (60% = baseline)
3
Score multiplier: min(|fused_score| / 0.3, 1.5)  (cap at 1.5×)
4
Apply: allocation = 20% × conf_mult × score_mult
5
Clamp: max(10%, min(allocation, 40%))
6
Volatility: if ATR regime = high → position × 0.8

## Entry/Exit level calculation (BUY example)
entry   = current_price
risk    = price × stop_loss_pct
stop    = price × (1 − stop_loss_pct)
target1 = price + risk × 2.0  # 2:1 risk-reward
target2 = price + risk × 3.0  # 3:1 risk-reward
🔄 Walk-forward optimization: python scripts/optimize_thresholds.py --period 180 · 126-day train / 42-day test windows

Reversal Signal Monitoring
🔄 BUY → Exit Triggers
• Price drops below 50-day MA
• RSI breaks above 70 (overbought)
• High-vol: price drops 5%+ in one day
• Major negative news event
🔄 SELL → Cover Triggers
• Price breaks above MA50 with volume
• RSI drops below 30 (oversold)
• Price drops 3% from entry (low conf)
• Major positive news catalyst
